Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses GFP-Trap for affinity purification (AP-MS) to identify SART3 interactors. While the study focuses on arginine methylation (SDMA), the MS analysis was a general AP-MS screen using LFQ. The search parameters explicitly included arginine methylation and other PTMs (phospho, diGly/GG, acetyl) as variable modifications.

scope: Whole cell lysates were incubated with GFP-trap agarose for 2 h at 4°C. Then the agarose was washed, and the bound proteins were eluted and separated on polyacrylamide gels for western blot analysis or for LC-MS analysis.

Hela cells were transfected with GFP-EV, GFP-SART3(WT), GFP-SART3(Y112A) or GFP-SART3(W377A) plasmids, total cell lysates were harvested 48h later and incubated with GFP-Trap beads for IP-MS analysis.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by mass spectrometry was obtained via GFP-Trap affinity purification from whole cell lysates, identifying protein complexes associated with the GFP-tagged baits.
